What it maps them onto — figures, the four worlds, chapters, Vortex beats — lands on pages that exist. Named but unpaged, as before: Witness-Funktion (Layer 1 and 3), Suppressionsprotokoll, Qualia-Informationsparadox, Semantische Firewall; each left unpaged by earlier readings, the question already with the author in NOW.md.
